chapter.verse: Keimah in leitungmite’ kam ahi zongin, vantungmite’ kam ahi zongin ka gen theih hangin itna ka neih kei leh, a ging thei dak, a ging thei daltuah tawh kibang ka hi ding hi.
Kamsangte’ pilna nei-in, thuthuk khempeuh, pilna khempeuh thei siam a, mual kinsak zawh nading upna apawl apawl ka neih hangin itna ka neih kei leh, a mawkna teitei ka hi hi.
Mizawngte vaak dingin ka sum khempeuh ka hawmsak tham loin, ka pumpi meikhul dingin ka piak hangin itna ka neih kei leh, ka phattuamna om lo hi.
Itna in a lungduai thei hi, a hehpih thei hi. Itna in ki-elna a om kei hi. Itna in a kisathei kei hi, a kiphasak thei kei hi,
a kituak loin a gamta kei hi, ama phat nading a zong kei hi, a heh baih thei kei hi, gitlohna a ciamteh kei hi,
gitlohna thu-ah a lungdam thei kei hi, thuman thutak ah a lungdam thei hi,
na khempeuh a thuak thei hi, na khempeuh a um thei hi, na khempeuh a thuak keeikaai hi.
Itna in a mangthang kei ding hi. Kamsangte’ thu a om leh a mangthang ding hi. Pautuam gen theihna a om leh, a bei ding hi. Lungpilna a om leh, a mangthang ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in kicing loin i thei hi, kamsangte’ pilna tawh kicing loin i hilh hi.
Ahih hangin kicin’na a tun’ ciangin a kicing lote a mangthang ding uh hi.
Naupang ka hih lai takin naupang bangin thu ka gen hi, naupang bangin ka ngaihsun hi, naupang bangin ka hanciam hi. Ahih hangin ka khan’ khit ciangin naupang nate ka paaikhia hi.
Tu lai takin kimu tel loin limlang sungah i en hi. Tu nung ciangin i maitang a tel takin i mu ding hi. Tu-in a kicing loin ka thei hi. Tu nung ciangin Pasian in kei hong theih bangin ka thei ding hi.
Tu-in upna, lawpna, itna hih thute thum a om uh hi. A thumte sungpan itna thu a lianbel hi.
